rule: READ-ONLY walk. No ingestion run, master sync, pipeline or snapshot was triggered - ten parallel walkers share this live database and a run would rewrite device state and ticket data underneath them.

items.name: ING-01 reverse - does restoring a departed device reopen the tickets the departure closed?
items.why: Requires a master sync that flips a device back to DEPLOYED/ACTIVE so restoreDepartures() runs.
items.fixture: A seeded device with an open DeviceDeparture (reason ABSENT_FROM_READ) plus its CLOSED/DEVICE_UNDEPLOYED_CLOSE tickets, and a sync source row that returns it to DEPLOYED. Read at E2 today: device-departure.service.ts:395-420 performs zero ticket writes.
